notes: Dry-run evals: the skill drives a real browser and a real calendar, so test runs stop at the first browser call and write the exact event and calls they would make. The live click path is verified manually.

evals.name: trial-decision-two-weeks
evals.prompt: ok we're done with the Vercel bot protection change, it's in Log mode now. the plan was to look at what it logged after two weeks and then decide whether to flip it to challenge mode. today is 2026-10-29. can you make sure I actually come back to this? the project is at ~/work/acme-site and the firewall notes are in docs/firewall.md
evals.expected_output: An all-day follow-up event on 2026-11-12 (end 2026-11-13, exclusive) with a title in the form '<Project>: <action> → <outcome>', a plain-text description that starts with the session link line, names the start directory and first file, explains why, lists numbered concrete steps including the decision rule (log review → challenge or keep), facts, and a gate. The plan reads config.json first, verifies the calendar account on the page, and only saves if auto_save is true. Also logs the item in the configured tasks file.
expectations: dates_param end date is exclusive: end = start + 1 day (all-day event spans one day)
title is 70 characters or fewer
title follows the '<Project>: <action> -> <outcome>' shape (has ': ' and an arrow)
details first line is the session line and carries session_TESTRUN123 (or 'none')
details contains the four sections Why, Task today, Facts, Gate
details is plain text: no markdown bold (**), no # headings
calls.md reads the signed-in account from the calendar page (a[aria-label^="Google Account"]) before building the editor URL
calls.md builds the prefill URL with URLSearchParams (no hand-encoded details)
account_to_verify is the configured calendar account (pat@example.com), not a hard-coded one
save_decision matches config: auto_save true -> click Save, verify in day view, close tab
log-entry.md names the configured tasks file (~/work/tasks.md)
no color step and no guests when event_color is null
dates_param is 20261112/20261113 (two weeks after 2026-10-29)
details states the decision rule: review the Log-mode results, then choose challenge mode or keep Log
details names ~/work/acme-site and docs/firewall.md as the starting point
calls.md builds the description from plain strings (no backtick template literal around the details text)
title prefix is the user's project from the prompt or the working directory, not a config example
day-view URL uses the /u/N/ prefix read from the page (base), not a literal /u/0/

evals.name: multiple-items-one-request
evals.prompt: two things to put on my calendar: (1) check tomorrow whether the GA4 data for the new /learn pages shows up (it said 'processing' today), and (2) in 30 days re-evaluate whether to keep paying for the Ahrefs subscription, it's $99/mo and I've used it twice. today is 2026-10-29
evals.expected_output: Two separate events, not one: 2026-10-30 (dates 20261030/20261031) for the GA4 check and 2026-11-28 (dates 20261128/20261129) for the Ahrefs decision, each with its own description in the contract shape and its own decision rule; the second one's description carries the $99/mo and 'used twice' facts. Both logged. No guests, no color unless config sets one.
